description: This file defines the HelpPageSampleGenerator class, which generates sample request and response bodies for API documentation in a .NET Web API project. It manages sample objects, formatters, and serialization for help page generation.

classes.name: HelpPageSampleGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating sample request and response bodies for API help pages, managing sample objects, formatters, and serialization.

methods.name: GetSampleRequests
methods.description: Returns sample request bodies for a given API description.

methods.name: GetSampleResponses
methods.description: Returns sample response bodies for a given API description.

methods.name: GetSample
methods.description: Generates request or response body samples based on API description and sample direction.

methods.name: GetActionSample
methods.description: Retrieves a specific sample for an action based on media type, controller, action, parameters, and sample direction.

methods.name: GetSampleObject
methods.description: Obtains or generates a sample object of a specified type for serialization.

methods.name: ResolveHttpRequestMessageType
methods.description: Resolves the actual type of HttpRequestMessage content for an API.

methods.name: ResolveType
methods.description: Determines the type of an action parameter or return value, considering HttpRequestMessage or HttpResponseMessage usage.

methods.name: WriteSampleObjectUsingFormatter
methods.description: Serializes a sample object using a specified media formatter and returns the serialized representation.

methods.name: UnwrapException
methods.description: Unwraps aggregate exceptions to retrieve the innermost exception.
